Name: Replacement Sensor Model Identification Version A
Description: The Replacement Sensor Model (RSM) Identification TRE (RSMID) is always supplied in image RSM support data. It contains various identifiers, provides a time of image model, defines the RSM primary ground coordinate system, specifies the applicable RSM image domain relative to the original full image, provides an approximation of the corresponding RSM ground domain, provides an optional illumination direction model, and provides an optional sensor trajectory model.

IID.Name: Image Identifier
IID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the original full image that corresponds to the associated image. This is not to be confused with the identification of an image derived by filtering, chipping, resampling, or other such image to image transformations. The image identifier is left justified with trailing spaces.

EDITION.Name: RSM Image Support Data Edition
EDITION.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the RSM support data for the associated original full image. It is to consist of an identifier of up to 20 characters for the processor that generated the RSM support data, to which is appended up to 20 characters that are unique among RSM TRE sets that are generated by that processor.

ISID.Name: Image Sequence Identifier
ISID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies an image sequence acquired by a single sensor. The associated image is a member of this image sequence.

SID.Name: Sensor Identifier
SID.Description: This field contains a character string that identifies the specific sensor used to acquire the associated image. Analogous to STDIDC mission. Must be unique among images of a given sensor type.

STID.Name: Sensor Type Identifier
STID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the capabilities of the sensor used to acquire the associated image, including make, model, processing chain, etc. Analogous to the CSM pedigree. The following conventions are strongly encouraged in order to support functionality that depends on their distinction: A. Inclusion of EO, IR, or SAR as applicable, b. inclusion of _RSM at the end.

YEAR.Name: Year of Image Acquisition
YEAR.Description: This field identifies the UTC year the image was taken.

MONTH.Name: Month of Image Acquisition
MONTH.Description: This field identifies the UTC month the image was taken.

DAY.Name: Month of Image Acquisition
DAY.Description: This field identifies the UTC day of the month that the image was taken.

HOUR.Name: Hour of Image Acquisition
HOUR.Description: This field identifies the UTC hour of the day that the image was taken.

MINUTE.Name: Minute of Image Acquisition
MINUTE.Description: This field identifies the UTC minute of the hour that the image was taken.

SECOND.Name: Second of Image Acquisition
SECOND.Description: This field identifies the UTC number of seconds past the minute that image acquisition occurred for the row 0, column 0 in the original full image. Note that the range exceeds 60 seconds due to a possible UTC leap second.

NRG.Name: Number of Rows Acquired Simultaneously
NRG.Description: This field contains the number of rows that are acquired simultaneously (in a single group).

NCG.Name: Number of Columns Acquired Simultaneously
NCG.Description: This field contains the number of columns that are acquired simultaneously (in a single group).

TRG.Name: Time Between Adjacent Row Groups
TRG.Description: This field contains the time period that elapses between a row group and the next higher group of rows. Allowed to have a negative value to accommodate an image inadvertently inserted in backwards time order.

TCG.Name: Time Between Adjacent Column Groups
TCG.Description: This field contains the time period that elapses between a column group and the next higher group of columns. Allowed to have a negative value to accommodate an image inadvertently inserted in backwards time order.

GRNDD.Name: Ground Domain Form
GRNDD.Description: This field uses an arbitrary ground point, specified with coordinates X, Y, and Z, and specifies the corresponging coordinate system as either Geodetic (G or H) or Rectangular (R). Geodetic, X, Y, and Z correspond to longitude, latitude, and height above the ellipsoid, respectively. Longitude is specified east of the prime meridian, and latitude is specified north of the equator. Units for X, Y, and Z, are radians, radians, and meters, respectively. The range for Y is (-pi/2 to pi/2). The range for X is (-pi to pi) when GRNDD=G, and (0 to 2pi) when GRNDD=H. The latter is specified when the RSM ground domain contains a longitude value near pi radians. If Rectangular, X, Y, and Z correspond to a coordinate system that is defined as an offset from and rotation about the WGS 84 Rectangular coordinate system. The field GRNDD specifies the applicable coordinate system for all ground points referenced in all RSM TREs for this image, unless specifically stated otherwise for a particular TRE.

XUOR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Origin (XUOR)
XUOR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X coordinate of the origin of the Rectangular coordinate system.

YUOR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Origin (YUOR)
YUOR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y coordinate of the origin of the Rectangular coordinate system.

ZUOR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Origin (ZUOR)
ZUOR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Z coordinate of the origin of the Rectangular coordinate system.

XUXR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (XUXR)
XUXR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X component of the unit vector defining the X axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

XUYR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (XUXR)
XUYR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X component of the unit vector defining the Y axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

XUZR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (XUZR)
XUZR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X component of the unit vector defining the Z-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

YUXR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (YUXR)
YUXR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y component of the unit vector defining the X-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

YUYR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (YUYR)
YUYR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y component of the unit vector defining the Y-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

YUZR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (YUZR)
YUZR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y component of the unit vector defining the Z-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

ZUXR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (ZUXR)
ZUXR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Z component of the unit vector defining the X-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

ZUYR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (ZUYR)
ZUYR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Z component of the unit vector defining the Y-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

ZUZR.Name: Rectangular Coordinate Unit Vector (ZUZR)
ZUZR.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Z component of the unit vector defining the Z-axis of the Rectangular coordinate system.

V1X.Name: Vertex 1 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V1X.Description: This field provides the value of the x coordinate of vertex V1 of the RSM ground domain.

V1Y.Name: Vertex 1 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V1Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V1 of the RSM ground domain.

V1Z.Name: Vertex 1 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V1Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V1 of the RSM ground domain.

V2X.Name: Vertex 2 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V2X.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V1 of the RSM ground domain.

V2Y.Name: Vertex 2 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V2Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V2 of the RSM ground domain.

V2Z.Name: Vertex 2 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V2Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V2 of the RSM ground domain.

V3X.Name: Vertex 3 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V3X.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V2 of the RSM ground domain.

V3Y.Name: Vertex 3 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V3Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V3 of the RSM ground domain.

V3Z.Name: Vertex 3 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V3Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V3 of the RSM ground domain.

V4X.Name: Vertex 4 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V4X.Description: This field provides the value of the x coordinate of vertex V4 of the RSM ground domain.

V4Y.Name: Vertex 4 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V4Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V4 of the RSM ground domain.

V4Z.Name: Vertex 4 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V4Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V4 of the RSM ground domain.

V5X.Name: Vertex 5 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V5X.Description: This field provides the value of the x coordinate of vertex V5 of the RSM ground domain.

V5Y.Name: Vertex 5 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V5Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V5 of the RSM ground domain.

V5Z.Name: Vertex 5 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V5Z.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V5 of the RSM ground domain.

V6X.Name: Vertex 6 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V6X.Description: This field provides the value of the x coordinate of vertex V6 of the RSM ground domain.

V6Y.Name: Vertex 6 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V6Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V6 of the RSM ground domain.

V6Z.Name: Vertex 6 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V6Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V6 of the RSM ground domain.

V7X.Name: Vertex 7 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V7X.Description: This field provides the value of the x coordinate of vertex V7 of the RSM ground domain.

V7Y.Name: Vertex 7 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V7Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V7 of the RSM ground domain.

V7Z.Name: Vertex 7 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V7Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V7 of the RSM ground domain.

V8X.Name: Vertex 8 X Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V8X.Description: This field provides the value of the x coordinate of vertex V8 of the RSM ground domain.

V8Y.Name: Vertex 8 Y Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V8Y.Description: This field provides the value of the y coordinate of vertex V8 of the RSM ground domain.

V8Z.Name: Vertex 8 Z Coordinate of the RSM Ground Domain
V8Z.Description: This field provides the value of the z coordinate of vertex V8 of the RSM ground domain.

GRPX.Name: Ground Reference Point X
GRPX.Description: This field provides the x coordinate of the Ground Reference Point. The Ground Reference Point is optional. If not supplied, this field and the next two fields have values of all spaces.

GRPY.Name: Ground Reference Point Y
GRPY.Description: This field provides the y coordinate of the Ground Reference Point. The Ground Reference Point is optional. If not supplied, this field and the next two fields have values of all spaces.

GRPZ.Name: Ground Reference Point Z
GRPZ.Description: This field provides the z coordinate of the Ground Reference Point. The Ground Reference Point is optional. If not supplied, this field and the next two fields have values of all spaces.

FULLR.Name: Number of Rows in Full Image
FULLR.Description: This field contains the number of image rows covered by the original full image. This is ancillary information and not required for RSM implementation.

FULLC.Name: Number of Columns in Full Image
FULLC.Description: This field contains the number of image columns covered by the original full image. This is ancillary information and not required for RSM implementation.

MINR.Name: Minimum Row
MINR.Description: This field provides the minimum row value of the RSM image domain relative to the original full image.

MAXR.Name: Maximum Row
MAXR.Description: This field provides the maximum row value of the RSM image domain relative to the original full image.

MINC.Name: Minimum Column
MINC.Description: This field provides the minimum column value of the RSM image domain relative to the original full image.

MAXC.Name: Maximum Column
MAXC.Description: This field provides the maximum column value of the RSM image domain relative to original the full image.

IE0.Name: Illumination Elevation Angle Constant Coefficient
IE0.Description: This field provides the approximate angle from the local tangent plane coordinate system's horizontal ground plane to the primary source of scene illumination for image position (0, 0). Typically between -pi/2 and pi/2, though this range can be exceeded in order to ensure continuity of all computed elevation angles in an image. The illumination direction model is optional. If not supplied, this field and the next 11 fields have values of all spaces.

IER.Name: Illumination Elevation Angle Constant Coefficient Per Row
IER.Description: This field provides the approximate elevation angle change per image row.

IEC.Name: Illumination Elevation Angle Constant Coefficient Per Column
IEC.Description: This field provides the approximate elevation angle change per image column.

IERR.Name: Illumination Elevation Angle Coefficient Per Row Squared
IERR.Description: This field provides the approximate elevation angle change per image row squared.

IERC.Name: Illumination Elevation Angle Coefficient Per Row Column
IERC.Description: This field provides the approximate elevation angle change per image row column.

IECC.Name: Illumination Elevation Angle Coefficient Per Column Squared
IECC.Description: This field provides the approximate elevation angle change per image column squared.

IA0.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Constant
IA0.Description: This field provides the approximate angle clockwise from true north to the primary source of scene illumination (in the local tangent plane coordinate system's horizontal ground plane) for image position (0, 0). This is typically between negative pi and positive pi or 0 and 2 times pi, but can exceed both ranges. Range is chosen to ensure continuity of all computed azimuth angles in an image.

IAR.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Coefficient Per Row
IAR.Description: This field provides the approximate azimuth angle change per image row.

IAC.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Coefficient Per Column
IAC.Description: This field provides the approximate azimuth angle change per image column.

IARR.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Coefficient Per Row Squared
IARR.Description: This field provides the approximate azimuth angle change per image row squared.

IARC.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Coefficient Per Row-Column
IARC.Description: This field provides the approximate azimuth angle change per image row-column.

IACC.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Coefficient Per Column Squared
IACC.Description: This field provides the approximate azimuth angle change per image column squared.

SPX.Name: Illumination Azimuth Angle Coefficient Per Column Squared
SPX.Description: This field provides the approximate azimuth angle change per image column squared.

SVX.Name: Sensor x Velocity
SVX.Description: This field provides the sensor velocity x coordinate value at reference time t0.

SAX.Name: Sensor x Acceleration
SAX.Description: This field provides the sensor acceleration x coordinate value at reference time t0.

SPY.Name: Sensor y Position
SPY.Description: This field provides the sensor position y-coordinate value at reference time t0.

SVY.Name: Sensor y Velocity
SVY.Description: This field provides the sensor position y-coordinate value at reference time t0.

SAY.Name: Sensor y Acceleration
SAY.Description: This field provides the sensor acceleration ycoordinate value at reference time t0.

SPZ.Name: Sensor z Position
SPZ.Description: This field provides the sensor position z-coordinate value at reference time t0.

SVZ.Name: Sensor z Velocity
SVZ.Description: This field provides the sensor position z-coordinate value at reference time t0.

SAZ.Name: Sensor z Acceleration
SAZ.Description: This field provides the sensor acceleration zcoordinate value at reference time t0.
